name: Canonical Reasoning Runtime v2

prohibited: raw platform metric as latent node

runtime_rules: No scientific edge weight is consumed.
No empirical effect size is converted into a propagation coefficient.
Accepted edges can support canonical graph inference but causal language follows causal_status.
Provisional edges may generate hypotheses but cannot alone support strong conclusions.
System edges represent opportunity/enabling mechanics and do not automatically imply target occurrence.
Context modifiers change interpretation/qualification only until calibration justifies quantitative effects.
Raw platform metrics must pass through a measurement mapper before they can seed latent constructs.
Account-local feedback is stored separately and cannot mutate scientific knowledge.

feedback_isolation.update_rule: scientific evidence can change only through explicit research/version-control workflow
